text:
**The evidence does not establish whether forest protection rules were violated.** It shows a 0.6 ha tree-cover loss in 2022, of which 0.5 ha overlaps native forest mapped by Uruguay’s MGAP. The full loss area was mapped as forest in the JRC’s 2020 reference.

This warrants investigation, but satellite and forest-map evidence alone cannot establish the cause of the loss, whether it was authorized, or which rules apply. A compliance determination would require checking applicable protections and any permits or other relevant records.
